title: Fan-in bound for the constructed circuit
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ bits, and let $k$ be a natural number with $k\\le n$. The circuit constructed from $f$ and $k$ is well formed, and every gate reads at most two vertices.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ bits
